tijori.business_description: Shiprocket, incorporated in 2011, is an e-commerce enablement platform providing technology-driven logistics and merchant solutions. The company operates in the e-commerce enablement segment, offering domestic and cross-border shipping, fulfilment, checkout, payments, marketing, and merchant solutions.
